- `crates/nmp-content/src/embed_projection/variants.rs` — `EmbedKindProjection` enum + a typed `XProjection` struct per kind.
- `crates/nmp-content/src/embed_projection/mod.rs` — the ONE `match event.kind` dispatch (`resolve_embed_projection`) that builds the projection, either calling the owning NIP crate directly (nmp-nip01, nmp-nip84) or via a `OnceLock` adapter-registration seam (nmp-nip23's `register_article_projection_adapter`, used only where a direct dep would cycle). [...] - `crates/nmp-content/schema/embed_sidecar.fbs` + `src/wire/embed_sidecar_fb/{encode,decode}.rs` — FlatBuffers wire union carries the projection cross-FFI; every variant needs a table + encode/decode arm. Regen is gated through `ci/regenerate-flatbuffers.sh`, not raw flatc (repo rule).
